attempts.text: {"inventedFacts":[{"span":"They are currently surrounding the Marrow League settlements.","severity":"minor","reason":"briefing says besieging the League, not that all its settlements are surrounded"},{"span":"This is a reduction from the start of the year.","severity":"minor","reason":"repeats old news from the earlier bulletin; the briefing does not give the start-of-year figure"},{"span":"They are currently holding their ground.","severity":"minor","reason":"ongoing status the briefing does not report"},{"span":"They offered refuge to the Fenwick survivors previously.","severity":"minor","reason":"repeats old news from an earlier bulletin as an item"},{"span":"The Empire has taken Fenwick.","severity":"minor","reason":"changes razed to taken, which implies capture rather than destruction"}],"voice":2,"clarity":3,"tone":2,"overall":2,"comment":"The first line copies the briefing note, and two of the three later items just repeat old news (the Marrow League's three settlements and the Tribe's shelter).
